items.title: From Billable Hours to Smart Hours
items.summary: For decades, the legal profession has been measured by one metric: the billable hour. Every six-minute increment defines value, productivity, and performance. But in a world where technology can automate, summarize, and draft faster than ever before — is time still the right measure of worth? At Lexi, we believe it’s time to rethink what “productive” means in law. Because efficiency isn’t about billing more hours — it’s about doing smarter work in fewer hours.
